material_stability_limitation.executable_python_recipe:
# Run from F:/dev/ragnarok with C:/Python314/python.exe; synthetic CPU only.
import os
for key in ('OMP_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'):
    os.environ[key]='1'
os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=''
import json, numpy as np, torch
from tests.test_owned_pixel_objectives_v70 import owner
from ragnarok.learning.parser_v70 import CounterfactualParser
from ragnarok.learning.owned_perception_session_v70 import OwnedPerceptionSession
torch.set_num_threads(1)
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
torch.manual_seed(764)
model=CounterfactualParser().cpu()
unused,pool,_=owner(parser=model)
session=OwnedPerceptionSession(unused._collector,model,workers=1)
weights={name:p.detach().clone() for name,p in model.named_parameters()}
session.step([1],effects=[np.ones(12,np.float32)])
batch=session.step([0],effects=[np.full(12,.25,np.float32)])
frame=batch.observations[0]
named=list(model.named_parameters())
gradients=torch.autograd.grad(frame.identity.loss,[p for _,p in named],allow_unused=True)
active=[(name,g) for (name,_),g in zip(named,gradients) if g is not None]
l1=sum(g.double().abs().sum().item() for _,g in active)
l2=sum(g.double().square().sum() for _,g in active).sqrt().item()
name,largest=max(active,key=lambda item:item[1].abs().max().item())
assert all(torch.isfinite(g).all() for _,g in active)
assert all(torch.equal(p.detach(),weights[name]) for name,p in named)
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print(json.dumps(dict(parameters=sum(p.numel() for _,p in named),
    identity_supervised_anchors=frame.identity.supervised_anchors,
    I_loss=frame.identity.loss.item(),gradient_L1_float64=l1,
    gradient_L2_float64=l2,max_abs_gradient=largest.abs().max().item(),
    max_parameter=name,gradient_square_float32_has_inf=torch.isinf(largest.square()).any().item(),
    charged_frames=pool.report(0)['accounting']['charged_frames']),indent=2))

limitations: Synthetic CPU source review only. No native emulator, GPU, Atari/archive input, new seed, collector rollout, benchmark, optimizer step or learning gate was run.

Delivered-image time is a prospective convention, not proof of native gate lag equivalence. Initial and visibly reset anchors may contribute to I history; invisible resets cannot be detected from equal pixels.
Own predicted displacement under zero effect is not measured motion or a button-to-effect mapping. Own IDs and eligibility are not external object truth.

Shallow-copy safety depends on the exact reviewed PerceptionStream.observe and exclusive ownership of parser/collector. Reflective private access or concurrent external parameter mutation is outside this Python contract.
An exception may leave pending autograd graphs, plus traceback references, in memory. Capacities do not bound RSS; diagnostic records are copied but not persisted durably.
The material I gradient witness is preserved explicitly. Finite losses/gradients alone are insufficient to authorize training.
